edits.new:
# Printability is a graph predicate. Thread successful visits across fields and
# constructor siblings so a shared child type is checked once per request.
# Insert each ADT before descending, retaining the original recursive-type rule.
law j_printable:
  for +book: List<&2, KDef>
  for +ty: KTerm
  for +seen: List<&2, String>
  for +fuel: U32
  Bool

@unsafe
def j_printable(book, ty, seen, fuel):
  +done = j_printable_head(book, wnf(book, ty), seen, fuel)
  match done:
    case None{}: False{}
    case Some{visited}: True{}

law j_printable_head:
  for +book: List<&2, KDef>
  for +ty: KTerm
  for +seen: List<&2, String>
  for +fuel: U32
  Maybe<List<&2, String>>

@unsafe
def j_printable_head(book, ty, seen, fuel):
  kc(Maybe<List<&2, String>>, String.eq(tg(ty), "Eql"), u => Some{seen}, u => kc(Maybe<List<&2, String>>, String.eq(tg(ty), "ADT") && Bool.not(String.eq(nm(ty), "IO.OP")) && String.eq(dk(lookup(book, nm(ty))), "ADT"), u => j_printable_adt(book, ty, seen, fuel), u => None{}))

  for +seen: List<&2, String>
  for +fuel: U32
  Maybe<List<&2, String>>

@unsafe
def j_printable_adt(book, ty, seen, fuel):
  kc(Maybe<List<&2, String>>, String.contains("|U32|F32|Nat|Char|String|", "|" ++ nm(ty) ++ "|") || has_name(seen, term_key(ty)), u => Some{seen}, u => kc(Maybe<List<&2, String>>, String.eq(nm(ty), "Array"), u => j_printable_head(book, wnf(book, kid(ty, 0)), seen, fuel), u => j_printable_ctors(book, dc(lookup(book, nm(ty))), ks(ty), Con{term_key(ty), seen}, fuel)))

law j_printable_ctors:
  for +book: List<&2, KDef>
  for +ctors: List<&2, KDef>
  for +params: List<&2, KTerm>
  for +seen: List<&2, String>
  for +fuel: U32
  Maybe<List<&2, String>>

@unsafe
def j_printable_ctors(book, ctors, params, seen, fuel):
  match ctors:
    case Nil{}:
      Some{seen}
    case Con{d, rest}:
      j_printable_ctors_more(book, rest, params, fuel,
        j_printable_fields(book, j_specialize(book, dt(d), params), seen, fuel))

@unsafe
def j_printable_ctors_more(+book: List<&2,KDef>, +ctors: List<&2,KDef>,
  +params: List<&2,KTerm>, +fuel: U32, +done: Maybe<List<&2,String>>) -> Maybe<List<&2,String>>:
  match done:
    case None{}: None{}
    case Some{seen}: j_printable_ctors(book, ctors, params, seen, fuel)

  for +book: List<&2, KDef>
  for +ty: KTerm
  for +seen: List<&2, String>
  for +fuel: U32
  Maybe<List<&2, String>>

@unsafe
def j_printable_fields(book, ty, seen, fuel):
  kc(Maybe<List<&2, String>>, String.eq(tg(ty), "All"), u =>
    kc(Maybe<List<&2, String>>, U32.is_eq(qt(ty), 0), u => None{}, u =>
      j_printable_fields_more(book, kid(ty, 1), fuel,
        j_printable_head(book, wnf(book, kid(ty, 0)), seen, fuel))), u => Some{seen})

@unsafe
def j_printable_fields_more(+book: List<&2,KDef>, +ty: KTerm,
  +fuel: U32, +done: Maybe<List<&2,String>>) -> Maybe<List<&2,String>>:
  match done:
    case None{}: None{}
    case Some{seen}: j_printable_fields(book, ty, seen, fuel)
